# Spells options

10 options. Set them in the daemon's `.conf` file or `appsettings.json`. Full reference: [configuration.md](../configuration.md). All areas: [index](README.md).

Daemon says which server reads it. Reload says whether `.reload config` applies it: `live` is applied to the running server, `restart` keeps its value until the next start, `start` is read once when the daemon starts.

## `Spells`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RequireSpellFocus` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | `false` stops enforcing `SpellInfo.RequiresSpellFocus` on casts (read once by `SpellFocusFeature`); `true` is the retail behaviour. |

## `Spells:Casters`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Bonus:Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Retail (true): +damage, +healing, Amplify/Dampen Magic and healing-taken auras change spell damage and healing (vmangos SpellCaster.cpp:1457-1700, Unit.cpp:5175-5385). False keeps the raw spell data amounts and exists only to debug against base points. |

## `Spells:Mods`

| Option | Type | Default | Allowed | Daemon | Reload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ClassMaskFile` | `string` | `null` | text | World | start | The class-mask overlay file (`arcane-content-importer class-masks`): 64-bit masks for the modifier auras, because the spell DBC's EffectItemType is read as 32 bits. Unset means the DBC masks only (a warning at startup counts the modifier effects that then have no mask at all). A missing or malformed file fails startup. |
| `CustomCharges` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Shadow Trance (17941) and Netherwind Focus (22008) start with one charge whatever the spell data says (vmangos SpellAuras.cpp:1090-1099). Retail is true. |
| `Enabled` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Kill switch: false makes aura 107/108 inert again (no mod is registered, every value comes back unchanged), as before this area existed. Retail is true. |
| `HardcodedWardMods` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Frost Warding (11189, 28332) and Improved Fire Ward (11094, 13043) carry their modifier in code, not in data: a flat RESIST_MISS_CHANCE with a literal class mask (vmangos SpellAuras.cpp:2117-2155, builds after 1.10.2). Retail is true. |
| `InstantCastKeepsFlatCastTimeCharge` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Patch 1.11: a flat CASTING_TIME mod (Nature's Grace) is not spent by a spell an instant-cast percent mod (Nature's Swiftness) already made instant (vmangos Player::ApplySpellMod, Player.cpp:22444-22453, builds after 1.10.2). Retail is true; false spends it anyway. |
| `OwnerModsForPetsAndTotems` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | A pet or a totem reads the modifiers of the player that owns it (vmangos Unit::GetSpellModOwner, Unit.cpp:9008-9023): its spell cooldowns, costs and ranges follow the owner's talents. Retail is true. |
| `ReapplyPassives` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | After a modifier is added or removed, permanent self-cast passives it affects are removed and cast again so an amount that read a modifier is recomputed (vmangos Aura::ReapplyAffectedPassiveAuras, SpellAuras.cpp:1005-1075). Retail is true. |
| `SendClientModifiers` | `bool` | `true` | true \| false | World | start | Tell the client about every modifier change (SMSG_SET_FLAT_SPELL_MODIFIER / SMSG_SET_PCT_SPELL_MODIFIER, one packet per mask bit): the client needs them to show modified costs and cast bars (vmangos Player::SendSpellMod). Retail is true. |
